frame.name: Precision Frame
frame.description: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

origins.name: Gun and Run
origins.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

origins.name: Veist Stinger
origins.description: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Encore
perks.description: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

enhanced.name: Encore
enhanced.description:
Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.
Effect duration is improved.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

enhanced.name: No Distractions
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a very short period of time reduces flinch.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

enhanced.name: Outlaw
enhanced.description: Precision final blows greatly decrease reload time for an improved duration.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: Stats for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Clown Cartridge
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.

perks.name: Invisible Hand
perks.description: Repeatedly missing targets increases this weapon's stability for a short time. This buff lasts for a short duration after a target is hit.

enhanced.name: Invisible Hand
enhanced.description: Repeatedly missing targets increases this weapon's stability for a short time. This buff lasts for a longer duration after a target is hit.

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

enhanced.name: Fragile Focus
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns more quickly once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.description: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

enhanced.name: Compulsive Reloader
enhanced.description: Grants greatly increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.description: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

enhanced.name: Ensemble
enhanced.description: Substantially improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Moving Target
enhanced.description: Increased movement speed and improved target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Harmony
enhanced.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for an improved duration.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

enhanced.name: High-Impact Reserves
enhanced.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

enhanced.name: Focused Fury
enhanced.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

enhanced.name: Hip-Fire Grip
enhanced.description: Greatly increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

enhanced.name: Box Breathing
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

enhanced.name: Wellspring
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

enhanced.name: Thresh
enhanced.description: Defeating combatants with this weapon generates an improved small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

flavor: Light up the battlefield with brilliant colors.
